text: Machine-wide work queue: get_prioritized_ideas descends into linked repos, and black-box repo nodes show a status rollup
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: after linking 9 repos into the life graph, value flows into each repo node, but get_prioritized_ideas stops at the box. Asked 'what's most valuable on this machine', an agent must call it per graph and compare numbers that aren't on the same scale.

Felix 2026-11-23: comparing globally "only is possible if they are all connected into one graph with a single normalized total value that spreads to supporting idea spaces." So: ranking starts at one top graph (e.g. the life graph) whose root carries the total value. The value flowing into a repo node becomes that linked graph's total, and its ideas get their share of it, so all numbers are on the top graph's scale. Graphs not reachable through links from the top graph don't take part. Read-only: no edges into another graph's internals. Repo nodes also show a rollup (open/partially counts, last activity).

Refuted if the cross-graph ranking stays worse than ranking each graph alone.

status.comment: Rollup done for linked spaces checked out on this machine: linkedRepo.list returns activity {ideas, open (open + partially), lastChange} read by spaces/activity.ts (counts only, never content), or missing: true when the registered folder no longer holds a space. MCP list_linked_repos shows both (missing points to find_spaces_on_disk + register_linked_repo); the project settings' linked-repo chip reads 'checked out · 4 open · 2 days ago' or 'folder moved'. Evidence: backend linked-repos.test new case (2 ideas, 1 open; after moving the folder resolved stays true, missing true, no activity), MCP repo-links test asserts activity, ProjectSettingsModal.spec chip labels; pnpm check 25/25. Not done: (1) the canvas repo node itself showing the rollup — a visual change for Felix to judge, (2) links by host to another server (would need that server's answer), (3) the main part: get_prioritized_ideas descending into linked spaces with value normalized from the top space.
